visual: Deep purple foliage · smooth grey bark · reddish-copper autumn colour
prune: Pruning Group 1; prune in late summer if required
cvs: syn. Fagus sylvatica Cuprea Group; Purple-leaved Group; Purpurea Group; 'Atropurpurea'; 'Cuprea'; 'Purpurea'
resilience: cold hardy · pollution tolerant · urban suitable
uncertain: The supplied name is a Group rather than a single cultivar; RHS accepts Fagus sylvatica (Atropurpurea Group) and lists numerous historical cultivar and Group synonyms
RHS states that Atropurpurea Group trees reach about 30 m over time and have a spread wider than 8 m; 20–30 m × 8–15 m is a practical planning range
